# Introduction
For my first blog post, I decided to finally start having some fun with Tidy Tuesday. It's been on my radar for a while now, and---as a degenerate MMA enthusiast---I finally answered the call after observing that this past Tuesday's challenge involved the UFCstats.com database. 

I've also been thinking more about interactivity in data visualization lately. It's probably about time I get more familiar with this kind of reporting, so I'm taking this opportunity to work with the super neat [ggiraph](https://davidgohel.github.io/ggiraph/) package for R. 

# The Data
Tidy Tuesday draws on the [fightr](https://github.com/benyamindsmith/fightr) package from Benjamin Smith, which allows easy access to the live database at [UFCstats.com](http://ufcstats.com/statistics/events/completed). As the website title suggests, this is the UFC's personal repository of fighter metrics. It hosts a litany of variables tracking fighters' career averages along with cumulative, fight-by-fight measures of striking and grappling performance.

# The Idea
I'm a big Max Holloway fan, and he's got a fight coming up this weekend, so I opted to look at a couple measures I'd seen plotted before in [this Reddit post](https://www.reddit.com/r/MMA/comments/1lzt6xx/visualizing_max_holloways_ridiculous_ufc_career/) from the data scientist [Nate Latshaw](https://linktr.ee/natelatshaw). It's a neat pairing of striking measures, and the data reveals a clear and interesting story about Holloway in particular. He's widely regarded as a technical and unrelenting striker, which is apparent enough from watching him, but it's cool to see the sheer anomaly of his career. 

I remember thinking when I first saw this post that I'd also like to take a look at a wider breadth of fighters. Several compelling stories emerge in Latshaw's visual, but there are natural limits to static text labels with this much data. Adding a bit of interactivity seems like a great fit for the especially curious fan. 

# The Plot

```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggiraph)
library(sysfonts)
sysfonts::font_add_google("Roboto Condensed")
sysfonts::font_add("Arial Narrow", regular = "ARIALN.ttf")
library(showtext)
library(hrbrthemes)
library(wesanderson)

load("ufc_data.rda")

invisible(list2env(ufc_data, envir = globalenv()))
rm(ufc_data)

ufc_athletes <- ufc_athletes |>
  mutate(
    sig_str_acc = sig_strikes_landed/sig_strikes_attempted)

num_ufc_fights <- ufc_fights |>
  group_by(f1_name) |>
  summarize(
    num_fights_1 = length(f1_result))

num_ufc_fights2 <- ufc_fights |>
  group_by(f2_name) |>
  summarize(
  num_fights_2 = length(f2_result))

names(num_ufc_fights)[1] <- "name"
names(num_ufc_fights)[2] <- "num_fights"

names(num_ufc_fights2)[1] <- "name"

checkerino <- merge(num_ufc_fights, num_ufc_fights2)

total_fights <- checkerino |>
  mutate(total_fights = num_fights + num_fights_2) |>
  select(name, total_fights)

ufc_athletes <- left_join(ufc_athletes, total_fights)

ufc_athletes <- ufc_athletes |>
  mutate(
    sig_att_rate = sig_strikes_attempted/total_fights)

active_five_sub <- ufc_athletes |>
  filter(total_fights >= 5 & status == "Active" & name != "Charles Radtke") |>
  drop_na(total_fights)

mean_acc <- mean(active_five_sub$sig_str_acc, na.rm = TRUE)

med_land <- median(active_five_sub$sig_strikes_attempted, na.rm = TRUE)
med_rate <- median(active_five_sub$sig_att_rate, na.rm = TRUE)

med_land <- median(active_five_sub$sig_strikes_landed, na.rm = TRUE)

med_land_min <- median(active_five_sub$sig_str_landed, na.rm = TRUE)

active_five_sub <- active_five_sub |>
  mutate(sig_str_diff = sig_str_landed - sig_str_absorbed)

med_diff <- median(active_five_sub$sig_str_diff, na.rm = TRUE)

active_five_sub <- active_five_sub |>
  mutate(
    profile = case_when(
      sig_strikes_landed >= med_land & sig_str_diff >= med_diff ~ "High volume, Elusive",
      sig_strikes_landed <= med_land & sig_str_diff >= med_diff ~ "Low-volume, Elusive",
      sig_strikes_landed >= med_land & sig_str_diff <= med_diff ~ "High-volume, Hittable",
      sig_strikes_landed <= med_land & sig_str_diff <= med_diff ~ "Low-volume, Hittable"
      
    )
  ) |>
  drop_na(profile)

tooltip <- paste0(
  active_five_sub$name, "\n",
  "\n Total Sig. strikes: ", active_five_sub$sig_strikes_landed,
  "\n Strikes landed/minute: ", active_five_sub$sig_str_landed,
  "\n Sig. strike diff: ", round(active_five_sub$sig_str_diff, digits = 2),
  "\n Total UFC bouts: ", active_five_sub$total_fights
)

showtext.auto()

my_plot <- active_five_sub |>
  filter(status == "Active" & total_fights >= 5 & name != "Charles Radtke") |>
  drop_na(profile, total_fights) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(x = sig_str_diff, y = sig_strikes_landed, color = profile,
                             tooltip = tooltip, data_id = name, hover_nearest = FALSE)

  ) +
  #geom_text_repel(
    #min.segment.length = 0,
    #max.overlaps = 15
  #) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = med_land, color = "yellow") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = med_diff, color = "yellow") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-4,4, 2 )) +
  labs(
    title = "Striking Volume and Elusivity in UFC Fighters",
    subtitle = "Active fighters with at least 5 UFC bouts",
    x = "Significant strikes landed/minute - absorbed/minute",
    y = "Total signifncant strikes landed",
    caption = "Created by Daulton Selke \n Data: fightr package & UFCStats.com"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual_interactive(values = wes_palette("AsteroidCity1")) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  theme_ft_rc(
    plot_margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6, unit = "pt"),
    caption_size = 7,
    axis_title_size = 12,
    grid = FALSE,
    axis = TRUE,
    ticks = TRUE
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.caption.position = "plot"
  )

girafe(ggobj = my_plot,
       options = list(
         opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.1")
       ))


```
